title: The place worth coming back to
logline: A remote mountain lodge reopens after a storm, and the audience should feel the journey from isolation to confidence that it is alive again.
visual_style: Cinematic mountain aerials with restrained movement, natural light, and a clear sense of destination.
must_show: The lodge in its remote mountain setting
A discoverable route toward the entrance
Signs of people, light, and recovery
constraints: All capture guidance is manual and advisory.
Maintain a safe distance from terrain, people, structures, and weather hazards.
Do not treat a recommendation as a flight command.

beats.title: Isolation
beats.story_job: Establish distance and vulnerability before the audience knows the destination.
beats.required_visual_proof: A high wide image with the lodge small in a large landscape.

beats.title: Discovery
beats.story_job: Let the audience find the lodge inside the landscape.
beats.required_visual_proof: A descending or forward reveal in which the lodge grows in frame.

beats.title: Invitation
beats.story_job: Make the destination feel reachable and welcoming.
beats.required_visual_proof: A smooth approach or lateral move toward the entrance.

beats.title: Renewal
beats.story_job: Show human activity and recovery after the storm.
beats.required_visual_proof: An orbit or rise revealing people, lights, or movement.

beats.title: Confidence
beats.story_job: End with scale and a resolved destination the audience can trust.
beats.required_visual_proof: A pull-away or elevated closing image with a clear destination.

initial_shot.notes: The lodge is small in a broad mountain landscape; isolation is visible, but the route and human renewal are not yet proven.
initial_shot.contribution: The current shot proves the lodge is remote and vulnerable.
initial_shot.limitations: It does not yet show how the audience discovers the lodge, reaches it, or sees it come back to life.
